acts.name: Tideglass Archipelago
acts.theme: Lists, indexing, and iterating over collections across sunlit coral islands.

acts.name: Clockwork Spire
acts.theme: While loops, counters, and steam-powered automation inside a brass tower.

acts.name: Alchemist's Caldera
acts.theme: Custom Python functions (def/return) and dictionaries in volcanic crystal labs.

acts.name: Shattered Skyway
acts.theme: Nested loops, combined data structures, and intro classes leading to Lord Null's 16-Bit Throne.

realms.name: Coral Shallows

dragon.name: Ripple
dragon.title: Dancer of the Lagoon
dragon.rescueDialogue: Splash-sparkle! Lists hold whole schools of treasures at once! Take Bit 9—the reef is shimmering!

realms.miniVisualUpgrade: Bit 9 Restored: Multi-layered 16-bit turquoise lagoon water with swaying coral fronds.
realms.storyIntro: Your ship lands on the sunlit beaches of Coral Shallows in crisp 16-bit detail! Sea dragon Ripple is tangled in a list of glowing reef crystals.
realms.storyOutro: Ripple leaps through the surf and restores Bit 9! The Tideglass Archipelago opens its sea-lanes to your crew.

trials.title: Chart the Reef Crystals
trials.storyPrompt: Four glowing reef crystals hum beneath the lagoon: ["aqua", "pearl", "coral", "amber"]. Ripple needs the first crystal, the last crystal, and the total count!
trials.objective: Given crystals = ["aqua", "pearl", "coral", "amber"], set first_crystal to the first item (index 0), last_crystal to the last item (index -1), and crystal_count to len(crystals).

starterCode.explorer:
crystals = ["aqua", "pearl", "coral", "amber"]
first_crystal = crystals[0]
last_crystal = crystals[-1]
# Now find how many crystals are in the list using len()
crystal_count =
starterCode.standard:
crystals = ["aqua", "pearl", "coral", "amber"]
# Set first_crystal, last_crystal, and crystal_count
starterCode.challenge:
crystals = ["aqua", "pearl", "coral", "amber"]
# Extract the first and last crystals by index and store the list length in crystal_count.

trials.referenceSolution:
crystals = ["aqua", "pearl", "coral", "amber"]
first_crystal = crystals[0]
last_crystal = crystals[-1]
crystal_count = len(crystals)
trials.testCode:
assert first_crystal == "aqua", f'Expected "aqua", got {first_crystal!r}'
assert last_crystal == "amber", f'Expected "amber", got {last_crystal!r}'
assert crystal_count == 4, f'Expected 4, got {crystal_count}'

hints.tier1_nudge: Pip splashes in the shallows: 'Python lists start counting at 0, and -1 grabs the very last item!'
hints.tier2_pattern:
first_crystal = crystals[0]
last_crystal = crystals[-1]
crystal_count = len(crystals)

realms.name: Driftwood Market

dragon.name: Gullwing
dragon.title: Scout of the Trade Winds
dragon.rescueDialogue: Squawk-roar! Every crate accounted for! Take Bit 10—watch the market banners billow!

realms.miniVisualUpgrade: Bit 10 Restored: Animated cloth market awnings and bobbing wooden piers.
realms.storyIntro: Floating stalls bob on the tide at Driftwood Market, where sea-breeze dragon Gullwing is trapped beneath scrambled cargo lists.
realms.storyOutro: Gullwing soars above the masts, restoring Bit 10 as colorful pennants unfurl across the harbor.

realms.name: Pearl Grotto

dragon.name: Nacre
dragon.title: Keeper of Luminous Shells
dragon.rescueDialogue: Shimmering work! You sorted the pearls by index and value! Take Bit 11!

realms.miniVisualUpgrade: Bit 11 Restored: Iridescent caustic light ripples across cavern ceilings.
realms.storyIntro: Inside the glowing sea-caves of Pearl Grotto, crystal-shelled dragon Nacre waits behind tide-locked pearl chests.
realms.storyOutro: Nacre's pearlescent glow fills the grotto and restores Bit 11.

realms.name: Maelstrom Lighthouse

dragon.name: Tempest
dragon.title: Warden of the Sea-Storm
dragon.rescueDialogue: Boom! The lighthouse lens is lit and Act I is yours! Onward to the Clockwork Spire!

realms.miniVisualUpgrade: Bit 12 Restored: Sweeping 16-bit lighthouse searchlight beam and crashing foam waves.
realms.storyIntro: A swirling whirlpool guards Maelstrom Lighthouse, where storm dragon Tempest needs filtered beacon lists to pierce the fog.
realms.storyOutro: Tempest calms the whirlpool, restores Bit 12, and clears the sea-route to the towering Clockwork Spire.

realms.name: Brass Courtyard

dragon.name: Sprocket
dragon.title: Tinker of the First Gear
dragon.rescueDialogue: Clink-whirrr! Your while-loop kept the gears turning without jamming! Take Bit 13!

realms.miniVisualUpgrade: Bit 13 Restored: Interlocking animated brass gears and golden steam vents.
realms.storyIntro: Giant bronze gears groan outside the Clockwork Spire. Mechanical dragon Sprocket needs careful while-loops to wind the main spring.
realms.storyOutro: Sprocket clicks free from the gear-cage and restores Bit 13.

realms.name: Pendulum Halls

dragon.name: Tock
dragon.title: Keeper of Steady Rhythm
dragon.rescueDialogue: Tick-tock, right on the beat! Take Bit 14!

realms.miniVisualUpgrade: Bit 14 Restored: Swinging 16-bit pendulum shadows and sunlit dust motes.
realms.storyIntro: Swinging brass pendulums cross the narrow walkways of Pendulum Halls. Dragon Tock is frozen mid-chime until your loops time the gaps.
realms.storyOutro: Tock chimes a victorious chord and restores Bit 14.

realms.name: Steam Foundry

dragon.name: Piston
dragon.title: Forgemaster of Pressure
dragon.rescueDialogue: Pssshhh! Perfect valve pressure! Take Bit 15!

realms.miniVisualUpgrade: Bit 15 Restored: Glowing furnace embers and billowing 16-bit steam clouds.
realms.storyIntro: Roaring boilers power the Steam Foundry, where dragon Piston's cage is locked by pressure gauges controlled with while-loops and lists.
realms.storyOutro: Piston vents a celebratory plume of steam and restores Bit 15.

realms.name: Grand Chronometer

dragon.name: Aether
dragon.title: Sovereign of the Spire
dragon.rescueDialogue: The Spire chimes again! Act II is complete—the Alchemist's Caldera awaits!

realms.miniVisualUpgrade: Bit 16 (Act II Crest) Restored: Rotating star-chart ceiling and golden clock-hand reflections.
realms.storyIntro: At the summit of Clockwork Spire sits the Grand Chronometer, where dragon Aether is bound by synchronized for- and while-loops.
realms.storyOutro: Aether restarts the Spire's star-clock and opens the bridge to the volcanic Alchemist's Caldera.

realms.name: Sulfur Terrace

dragon.name: Cinderel
dragon.title: Spark of the Ash-Springs
dragon.rescueDialogue: You brewed your first custom function spell! The Caldera warms to your code!

realms.miniVisualUpgrade: Act III Upgrade 1: Bubbling mineral pools with rising golden vapor.
realms.storyIntro: Steaming terraces ring the Alchemist's Caldera. Dragon Cinderel teaches you to package reusable spells using def.
realms.storyOutro: Cinderel glides across the warm thermals, lighting the path to the Crystal Alembic.

realms.name: Crystal Alembic

dragon.name: Prism
dragon.title: Refractor of Pure Values
dragon.rescueDialogue: Every function returned its exact crystal value! Shine on, Code-Tamer!

realms.miniVisualUpgrade: Act III Upgrade 2: Rainbow refraction beams across crystal floor tiles.
realms.storyIntro: Towering glass tubes fill the Crystal Alembic, where dragon Prism waits for functions that return exact potion measurements.
realms.storyOutro: Prism scatters a rainbow across the laboratory and unlocks the Potion Vault.

realms.name: Potion Vault

dragon.name: Elixir
dragon.title: Archivist of Recipes
dragon.rescueDialogue: Keys and values in perfect harmony! My recipe book is whole again!

realms.miniVisualUpgrade: Act III Upgrade 3: Glowing labeled potion shelves and floating rune-tags.
realms.storyIntro: Hundreds of enchanted flasks line the Potion Vault. Dragon Elixir needs Python dictionaries to match every label key to its ingredient value.
realms.storyOutro: Elixir seals the vault's leaks and opens the magma elevator to the Caldera's core.

realms.name: Magma Core

dragon.name: Crucible
dragon.title: Heart of the Caldera
dragon.rescueDialogue: Forged in functions and dictionaries! Ride the updraft to the Shattered Skyway!

realms.miniVisualUpgrade: Act III Crest Restored: Flowing 16-bit magma rivers and glowing obsidian bridges.
realms.storyIntro: In the blazing Magma Core, dragon Crucible is locked behind an alchemical engine that combines custom functions with recipe dictionaries.
realms.storyOutro: Crucible cools a spiral staircase of obsidian leading high into the clouds of Act IV.

realms.name: Cloud Dock

dragon.name: Nimbus
dragon.title: Harbormaster of the Skies
dragon.rescueDialogue: Grid cleared, airships ready! Nested loops make sky-charts a breeze!

realms.miniVisualUpgrade: Act IV Upgrade 1: Multi-layer parallax cloud sea beneath floating wooden docks.
realms.storyIntro: Skyships creak at the floating Cloud Dock. Dragon Nimbus needs nested loops to scan every row and column of the skyway grid.
realms.storyOutro: Nimbus launches the starlight skiff toward the Starlight Bridge.

realms.name: Starlight Bridge

dragon.name: Comet
dragon.title: Runner of Constellations
dragon.rescueDialogue: Blazing fast! Every star-node is mapped and shining!

realms.miniVisualUpgrade: Act IV Upgrade 2: Shimmering constellation bridges and shooting star streaks.
realms.storyIntro: Suspended between clouds, Starlight Bridge flickers in and out of existence. Dragon Comet relies on dictionaries and return functions to anchor each star tile.
realms.storyOutro: Comet streaks across the skyway, locking the bridge solid to Storm Bastion.

realms.name: Storm Bastion

dragon.name: Fulmin
dragon.title: Commander of Thunder
dragon.rescueDialogue: You built a true Python class! Now nothing can stop you at Null's Throne!

realms.miniVisualUpgrade: Act IV Upgrade 3: Dramatic thunderhead lighting and crackling sky-spire arcs.
realms.storyIntro: Lightning crackles around Storm Bastion, the final fortress before Lord Null. Dragon Fulmin introduces Python classes to blueprint storm-shields.
realms.storyOutro: Fulmin shatters the bastion gates, revealing Lord Null's 16-Bit Throne.

realms.name: Null's 16-Bit Throne

dragon.name: Zenith
dragon.title: Sovereign of the Horizon
dragon.rescueDialogue: ALL SIXTEEN DRAGONS FLY FREE! Feel the horizon bend—the 3D Era of Pyria is awakening!

realms.miniVisualUpgrade: 16-BIT ERA COMPLETE — 3D HORIZON TEASER! The skyway lifts into full 3D perspective as all 24 rescued dragons circle above Pyria.
realms.storyIntro: Lord Null stands atop his 16-Bit Throne with prism dragon Zenith caged in a swirling matrix of glitches. Bring every 16-Bit Python skill to the final gauntlet!
realms.storyOutro: Zenith breaks free in a burst of prismatic light! Lord Null vanishes into a 3D rift, and Pyria prepares for its next great leap.
